title: Danielle B NDE 21538
content: When I lapsed into a coma then coded during the emergency C-section of my daughter, I saw myself floating above my body. I could see them standing over my body and blood was everywhere. I turned to my left and there was an extremely bright light. I started walking towards it but the more I walked, the farther away it seemed. I couldn't make it there no matter how much I walked. Then I felt a force, without actually seeing it. It spoke to me and told me that I needed to turn around and go back because it wasn't my time. I was needed for other things. I never saw this person with the voice but I felt the force pushing me back down towards my body. Before I went back into my body, I heard the doctors saying that they couldn't get a pulse or a heart measure and that they had tried it all. I was watching them shock me trying to get me back to life. At that point, the force told me that there were many things that I needed to do still and that I had a baby fighting for her life needing me. I remember going back down to my body and it was like a strong, steady vacuum.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related Clinical death . I coded on the table three times during what was supposed to be a routine delivery and I suffered a spleen artery aneurism.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Boundary
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I remember being whole above my body. There was an aura around my whole body.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: The only noise or sound that stays with me is the sound of the machines and the shockers.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was a bright, vibrant shining light to my far left. As I tried to go there it got farther and farther away.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I was keener to sights and sounds.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Very at peace. Especially when I saw the bright light and was going towards it.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told that it wasn't my time. I trusted what the force told me and returned to my body.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I now have a renewed faith and understanding for people who have said that they have had an out of body experience. I am part of it.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Seeing the worst shape my body has ever been in, and knowing that I had a reason to turn back. Knowing that I had a daughter to whom I could make a difference.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes ’ve shared with family and friends. It was mixed between believing me and thinking that I was full of crap.
